The '''pinboard''' is an object located in [[Watson's house]] which was introduced with the 2016 [[Treasure Trails]] [[Update:Treasure Trail Expansion (2016)|expansion]]. It displays the username of players that have submitted ideas for this and later Treasure Trails expansions.
